# Copilot Agent Experiments

> Practical, governed Microsoft agent starters for UK public bodies and FCA-regulated firms. Humans approve consequential actions.

Eighty-five starters are in this repository, in folders 01 to 85. Two flagship experiments are also published as their own repositories. More flagship experiments will get their own repos.

## Catalogue

- [README](https://github.com/rahul-bachina/copilot-agent-experiments/blob/main/README.md): What the series covers, and how to run a starter
- [Briefing site](https://rahul-bachina.github.io/copilot-agent-experiments/): The catalogue as a documentation site
- [Experiments](https://github.com/rahul-bachina/copilot-agent-experiments/tree/main/experiments): The experiment list, folders 01 to 85

## Standalone repos

- [FOI and complaint triage](https://github.com/rahul-bachina/foi-complaint-triage-copilot-agent): Experiment 01, published on its own. An officer approves every output. The agent does not send or reject.
- [Consumer Duty complaint intake](https://github.com/rahul-bachina/consumer-duty-complaints-copilot-agent): Experiment 02, catalogue ID C006, published on its own. DISP dates are calculated in code. A handler checks every classification.
